## Construction behind the new unsplit lemma

This paragraph is guidance for the next worker, not a proof inserted into the unsplit node. Restrict D's cross-Hom bimodule along the two given diagonal resolutions, and choose its projective cellular cofibrant replacement over C_U^op × C_V. A representable bimodule cell has the form C_U(-,u) × K × C_V(v,-). Since no two mixed arrows can be composed, adjoining this cell to the collage is exactly adjoining one enriched arrow cell with the two diagonal actions, without generating new diagonal or reverse arrows. Thus the cell construction preserves both full diagonals, and the collage is built from their coproduct by Bergner generating arrow cofibrations. For either diagonal inclusion first adjoin the other cofibrant diagonal and then these cells. Fixing either endpoint of a representable bimodule cell gives a free module cell with an additional simplicial-set factor; such factors preserve simplicial cofibrations. This gives the endpoint projective cofibrancy, including retracts. Functorial choices use all boundary lifting problems; a block-preserving functor sends each generator to its image problem, so object functions inside a block may identify objects. This is the genuine non-elementary construction separated from the item, not a renamed clause of the item.
